description: Example Claude Code settings for this project. The active copy is settings.json (schema verified in this environment). Source edits are gated by two hooks: check-plan-gate.sh (Tiny/Express/Standard/Deep plan acknowledgment in .claude/.plan-ack) and scripts/hooks/tdd-red-guard.mjs (guarded source stays locked until `bun run tdd:red` records failing tests for the branch; it also inspects Bash writes). check-gstack.sh guards Skill calls.
